content: TDEventFrameEthernet specifies events related to the ex- change of Ethernet frames The element TDEventFrameEthernet is used to spec- ify events, namely the exchange of Ethernet frames, observable between the Ethernet communication controller and the Ethernet specific BSW modules, as well as observ- able at the physical layer.
